scripts.format: pnpm --silent tools && prettier --write --log-level warn . && ruff format --quiet scripts/ && pnpm --silent format:shell
scripts.format:check: pnpm --silent tools && prettier --check --log-level warn --cache --cache-location node_modules/.cache/prettier/.prettier-cache --cache-strategy content . && ruff format --check --quiet scripts/ && pnpm --silent format:check:shell
scripts.format:check:shell: files=$(git ls-files '*.sh' 'scripts/hooks/*'); [ -z "$files" ] || { out=$(shfmt -l $files); [ -z "$out" ] || { echo 'Shell files need shfmt:' >&2; echo "$out" >&2; exit 1; }; }
scripts.lint: pnpm --silent tools && ruff check --quiet scripts/ && python3 scripts/lint_binaries.py && python3 scripts/update_agents_file_index.py --check
scripts.lint:fix: pnpm --silent tools && ruff check --quiet scripts/ --fix && python3 scripts/update_agents_file_index.py
scripts.verify: pnpm --silent tools && pnpm --silent format:check && pnpm --silent lint
